messages:
sarah: Heads-up: Cutover window set for Fri 2026-03-27 02:00-04:00 UTC. Freezes start 2026-03-26 18:00 PT — no merges after that unless approved. Please confirm your owners have run smoke tests and posted signoffs.

vince: Noted. Can we pin the serving stack to image digest sha256:7f4a2 for the window? That avoids drift.

elena: @vince +1 for pin. Oncall will watch error rate and latency for first 30m.

mike: Agree on pin. I'll stage the canary group (10%) and validate memory/latency under load by 01:30 UTC.

julie: Release notes live at https://intra.redwood/release/3.7.0 — callout: embedding cold-start fix, batching opt. QA has a short checklist in the doc.

sarah: Rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback if 3-min error rate >2% or p99 latency >1200ms for canary. Manual rollback trigger if functional regressions seen in smoke scripts. Thoughts?

elena: Those thresholds look good. Add one more: API 5xxs >1% sustained for 5m -> escalate.

vince: Pin confirmed: image sha256:7f4a2 pinned. Deploy config: 
```
deploy: canary_percent: 10
pin_image: yes
rollback_policy: auto
rollback_thresholds:
  error_rate_3m: 0.02
  p99_ms: 1200
```

mike: deploy-bot: scheduling canary at 2026-03-27T02:05:00Z for rollout id=cr-9876

deploy-bot: [INFO] kickoff: started canary rollout cr-9876 -> group A (10%). logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/cr-9876

elena: Smoke results: all checks passing on staging, no regressions in basic flows. Confirm prod smoke script run by @mike at 02:10 UTC.

mike: Running prod smoke at 02:10 now. Quick log snippet: 
```
INFO connecting to /svc/model
INFO batch warmup ok
INFO p99=430ms p50=56ms
```

vince: Observability: I pushed a dashboard link to #eng-runtime — please watch canary: error-rate, p99, token-rate, cache-hit.

sarah: Final safety steps before freeze: tag release branch, pin images (done), inform CS & SRE, confirm runbook availability. Anyone missing anything?

julie: I'll ping CS with the customer-impact blurb.

elena: Oncall will stand by for 60m post-traffic-shift. If auto-rollback fires, please do not unfreeze until postmortem triage: we want root cause.

mike: If we need a hotfix during freeze, follow the exemption flow: open #eng-releases thread + approval from eng-release lead + oncall.

vince: All set from infra side. Good luck. :rocket:

sarah: Thanks team — we'll reconvene in this thread with rollout updates.
